description: Kampala Capital City Authority, which runs the Ugandan capital, keeps a central spatial database in the GIS Section of its physical planning directorate to serve city-wide applications. The section page read on 2026-09-28 lists its contents: administrative layers (Greater Kampala Metropolitan Area, city boundary, central business district), cadastre information from the Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development, elevation data for terrain models, utility maps, hydrology layers, land use maps, water and sanitation lines, transport maps and zoning maps locating places of interest and public institutions, and satellite imagery for 2010 and 2014, with projects such as the KCCA Atlas and a City Address Model. Coverage is the city of Kampala. Access is free: maps can be downloaded from the KCCA data catalogue or requested; no licence or formats are stated. Caveats: the catalogue itself was not read, layer dates and accuracy are not given, and imagery is old. It supports hazard exposure analysis of Kampala's networks, for example flooding of water, sanitation and road assets, and network models built from the utility layers. No related Kampala record is catalogued; global building and road datasets complement it.
